description: Chainlink mid-market rate snapshot Lexicon per ADR-2605282200 G4 — emitted by Pregel cell `kawase_fx_oracle_watcher` whenever a relevant Chainlink price-feed round updates. councilBandBps reflects the Constitution.sol const `kawase.max_band_bps` (= 50 = ±0.5%) at attestation time. `withinBand=false` halts ALL match activity for the affected pair until a Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation chain resumes (separate operational record outside this Lexicon).

pair.description: Currency pair ISO-4217 / ISO-4217. R1 enum = USD/EUR only; JPY/KRW/GBP/CHF pairs unlock as R2/R3 add stables.

midMarketRateNumerator.description: Chainlink answer (signed int256 in Solidity, but kawase only uses positive rates) as integer-numerator.

chainlinkRoundId.description: Chainlink AggregatorV3Interface roundId at attestation. Used to detect stale rounds (cell rejects rounds older than 1 hour).

chainlinkUpdatedAt.description: Chainlink AggregatorV3Interface updatedAt converted to ISO-8601.

councilBandBps.description: Council-attested band tolerance at attestation time. Constitution.sol const kawase.max_band_bps. Default R0 = 50 (±0.5%).

withinBand.description: false = a check against pool-internal locked rates exceeded ±councilBandBps; cell halts pair matching and escalates to chigiri.disputeMediation after 5min sustained.

attestingNodeDid.description: DID of the Murakumo fleet node that ran this oracle watcher tick. MUST be a fleet.toml-listed node per G12.
